attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a DHCP server on the private eth1/enp8s0 network (10.50.50.0/24) shared with node2/node3, and configured node2/node3 (RHEL9) to obtain their address on that network via DHCP instead of static assignment, implemented entirely via an Ansible playbook run from node4 (the cluster's only Ansible-equipped node, used as control_node). Verified leases issued and held by node2/node3, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol across all four managed nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery on each.
